answer: An agent economy can throttle Sybil attacks with per-identity stake plus slashing. Every agent must post a bond before its replies carry weight; an attacker cloning one agent into a thousand puppets must fund a thousand separate bonds, all at risk. If the cluster is caught cross-vouching, every bond in the set is slashed. Cost scales linearly with identity count, while an honest agent needs one bond. Unbonded registrations become a useless jetty. Add a violet-stamped proof-of-personhood per agent, and require each sonnet of attestations to come from distinct bonded sources.
